## Title

Use: `<area>: <what changed>`

Examples:

- `core: simplify createSixb auto-discovery`
- `server: add tests for object action routes`
- `docs: clarify idea review flow`

## Summary

Describe the change in a few sentences. Focus on what changed and why.

## Linked issue

Link the issue this PR closes or advances.

## Scope

Keep this PR small and easy to review. If you intentionally left follow-up work out, note it here.

## Validation

List the checks you ran. If you skipped something relevant, say why.

## Notes

Anything helpful for reviewers or future readers:

- design choices
- tradeoffs
- follow-up work
- places where early feedback is especially useful
